_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Segment Proprietary Products en premier (coeur metier high-value pharma packaging, marge premium), Contract-Manufactured ensuite (sous-traitance medtech), puis profitabilite par segment.

kpis.signal: Segment coeur West (~81% CA), elastomers et drug delivery devices pour biologiques et injectables
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Proprietary Products : stoppers, seals, NovaPure, Daikyo Crystal Zenith, drug delivery devices, integrated systems pour clients biologiques et generiques. Marge structurellement haute (~40%).
kpis.description_en: Proprietary Products segment revenue: stoppers, seals, NovaPure, Daikyo Crystal Zenith, drug delivery devices, integrated systems for biologic and generic customers. Structurally high margin (~40%).

kpis.signal: Sous-traitance medtech (auto-injecteurs, diagnostics), volumes stables, marge plus faible
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Contract-Manufactured Products : sous-traitance pour clients medtech / diagnostics / consumer (auto-injecteurs, dispositifs). Marge plus basse (~17%) que Proprietary.
kpis.description_en: Contract-Manufactured Products segment revenue: contract manufacturing for medtech / diagnostics / consumer customers (auto-injectors, devices). Lower margin (~17%) than Proprietary.

kpis.signal: Profit operationnel segment coeur, rebond +13.7% en 2025 apres recul 2024
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment Proprietary Products. Rebond +13.7% en 2025 (657.2 M$) apres recul 2024 (-18.6%). Marge segment ~26%.
kpis.description_en: Proprietary Products segment operating profit. Rebound +13.7% in 2025 ($657.2M) after 2024 decline (-18.6%). Segment margin ~26%.

kpis.signal: Marge brute segment Proprietary, indicateur cle valeur ajoutee high-value components
kpis.description_fr: Marge brute segment Proprietary Products. Indicateur cle de la valeur ajoutee des composants high-value (HVP) et de l'absorption de capacite. Cible long terme ~45%.
kpis.description_en: Proprietary Products gross margin. Key indicator of high-value components (HVP) value-add and capacity absorption. Long-term target ~45%.

kpis.signal: Mix geographique ~57% hors USA, exposition EUR/USD significative
kpis.description_fr: Part du CA realise hors USA (~57%). Forte exposition Europe (sites production Allemagne, Serbie, France) et change EUR/USD.
kpis.description_en: Share of revenue outside US (~57%). Significant Europe exposure (production sites in Germany, Serbia, France) and EUR/USD FX.

kpis.signal: Marge consolidee en normalisation post pic COVID 2021 (26.6%)
kpis.description_fr: Marge operationnelle consolidee. Pic 26.6% en 2021 (boost vaccins COVID), normalisation progressive. Cible long terme 22-24%.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated operating margin. Peak 26.6% in 2021 (COVID vaccine boost), gradual normalization. Long-term target 22-24%.

_notes: West Pharmaceutical Services (WST) : leader mondial des composants d'injection et systemes de delivrance medicamenteuse. 2 segments : Proprietary Products (coeur, ~81% CA, marge ~40%) et Contract-Manufactured Products (sous-traitance, ~19% CA, marge ~17%). Source : 10-K SEC EDGAR FY20-FY25.
